title: Minimum degree by industry
takeaway: A bachelor's degree is the usual minimum, but Government and public safety asks for a master's or higher most often (12% of postings that name a degree), while Retail mostly asks for less than a bachelor's (78%).

title: Majors by industry
takeaway: The most named major fits each field: CS/IT names Computer Science (44%), Health care names Nursing (50%), Finance names Business (40%).

title: Years by level
takeaway: Even entry level postings ask for experience: 34% of the ones that give a number ask for 3 or more years, and the median is 2 years.

title: Years by industry and level
takeaway: Entry level jobs ask for a median of 1 to 3 years and Director jobs 5 to 7 years; CS/IT asks the most at entry level (3 years).

title: Skills by industry
takeaway: Each field has its own top skill: CS/IT asks for Agile (14%) and Health care asks for Patient Care (41%).

title: Functions on the same posting
takeaway: Close job functions often share postings, for example Business Development and Sales (92%), so a person in one may be able to apply to the other.

title: Salary by industry and state
takeaway: Industry changes posted pay more than state does: CS/IT pays $85k to $152k in these states, while Retail pays $44k to $58k.
